title: fix(hub): require the run read grant on every verdict route
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed
- One guard checks membership and the run read grant; the verdicts, timeline, stats and Do list routes all use it.

## Verification
- New Postgres test with real grants: a user without the run read grant gets 403 from all four routes.
- `bun run check`, `bun run test` (691 pass).
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(hub): require the run read grant on every verdict route
